newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - OCTOBER 16.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - OCTOBER 16.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 13.6 million zlotys on Wednesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions through the Warsaw bourse.
* 96,472 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on November 5, 1996 traded at 101.8 zlotys.
* 31,009 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on July 5, 1997 traded at 103 zlotys.
